common: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production-ready 1536x1024 transparent PNG sprite atlas for Mineworld Sunlit Quest. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, do not copy its background or layout. Match its friendly bright adventure pixel art, dark navy #112238 outlines, teal #399895, silver ivory #f0dfb8, antique gold #d7a447 and pale gold #ffe085, orange fire accents, crisp square pixel clusters, 3-4 discrete shades per material, upper-left highlights. Consistent 48x48-source-pixel visual density enlarged with hard pixel steps. NOT smooth vector, not 3D, no blur, no soft shadows, no diffuse glow, no gradients, no photographic texture. Actual transparent alpha background, NOT a painted checkerboard, NOT solid navy or white. Exactly FIVE separate icons in a precise invisible THREE COLUMN by TWO ROW grid of square 512x512 cells. Strict row-major order: top-left, top-middle, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-middle. Bottom-right cell must be completely transparent and empty. Each icon centered within its cell and wholly inside central 70% (at least 15% clear margin on every edge). Equal perceived size, bold readable silhouettes at mobile 40px. No borders, frames, tiles, labels, text, numbers, watermark, or extra icons. Each specified subject forms ONE coherent pictogram; no overlapping between cells. Subjects in strict order:
